description: Calculation applicability and grounding retrieval; manual AI expectations are not automated reasoning checks.

cases.prompt: Select dielectric data for the actual laminate construction
cases.ai_expectation: FR408HR values do not characterize every FR-4 board; published nominal data are not fabrication tolerances.

cases.prompt: Separate dielectric loss from impedance targeting
cases.ai_expectation: A material table alone does not model connector, conductor and via losses.

cases.prompt: Use a bounded microstrip estimate with explicit units
cases.ai_expectation: TI discusses best accuracy around 50-100 ohms. This is not a coupled-pair, coplanar or soldermask-aware solver; source examples are not guaranteed widths.

cases.prompt: Keep impedance, heating and voltage-drop calculations separate
cases.ai_expectation: KiCad 9 documentation describes IPC-2221 track-width estimates. Check the installed version; those estimates are not measured thermal qualification or IPC-2152 certification.

cases.prompt: Review system ground loops without cutting signal references
cases.ai_expectation: Do not treat all multiple ground connections as faults or split a plane automatically. This guidance does not authorize altering protective-earth or isolation provisions.

cases.prompt: Check noise caused by shared return impedance
cases.ai_expectation: This mechanism is distinct from merely spotting a geometric loop. Follow the converter-specific grounding requirements.
